from pathlib import Path
import re

in_path = Path('/inputs/report.html')
out_path = Path('/work/report.html')

raw = in_path.read_bytes()
text = raw.decode('utf-8')

# Find existing closing head tag (case-insensitive), ensure unique target
matches = list(re.finditer(r'</head\s*>', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE))
if not matches:
    raise SystemExit('No closing </head> tag found.')
# Use the last closing head tag (typically only one)
m = matches[-1]

insert = '\n<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview)">\n<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'

new_text = text[:m.start()] + insert + text[m.start():]
out_path.write_text(new_text, encoding='utf-8', newline='')

# Local checks
out = out_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

# Check inserted tags count and placement near </head>
desc_pat = re.compile(r'<meta\s+name="description"\s+content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions \(preview\)"\s*/?>', re.IGNORECASE)
rob_pat = re.compile(r'<meta\s+name="robots"\s+content="noindex, nofollow"\s*/?>', re.IGNORECASE)

print('Input bytes:', len(raw))
print('Output bytes:', len(out.encode('utf-8')))
print('Description tag matches:', len(desc_pat.findall(out)))
print('Robots tag matches:', len(rob_pat.findall(out)))

# Verify immediate pre-head insertion snippet
snippet_start = max(0, m.start()-120)
snippet_end = min(len(new_text), m.start()+220)
print('--- Snippet around insertion ---')
print(new_text[snippet_start:snippet_end])

# Verify unchanged outside insertion by removal comparison
removed = new_text.replace(insert, '', 1)
print('Outside-insertion unchanged:', removed == text)
